scope: Current-plan room grouping, locate, independent checklist and atomic lock/layer/purchase batches
syntax: Changed and new scripts, shared classic-script declarations and diff whitespace passed

browser.engine: Installed Microsoft Edge, fresh isolated profiles
browser.workspace: Isolated source copy, read-only static server; real project files were not used or changed
checks: Room/search intersection, unknown heights, hidden layers and outside items
Read-only 2D locate, existing group selection and exact checklist IDs
Lock/unlock, layer assignment and purchase states in one mutation per effective batch
Atomic locked-layer failure, disabled locked targets and no silent layer visibility changes
Layer manager creation refreshes destination options
Zero price/notes retained and spatial confirmation fingerprint unchanged
Undo/redo, autosave/refresh and stale checks cleared on room/query/plan changes
Narrow-screen batch actions, light/dark screenshots and English labels

persistence: Existing locked, objectLayers and purchaseStatus only; no format version or data migration added
boundaries: Room membership follows the furniture center, not full-footprint containment
Outside classification uses the wall/room bounding range; unclaimed concavities and holes remain unassigned
Checklist does not expand groups; canvas locate retains existing group behavior
Hidden layers must be shown explicitly through Layer manager
Physical touch-device acceptance and the full regression suite were not run
